# Farwa Beauty Salon

> Beauty salon in Block 3 PECHS, Karachi, Pakistan, operating since 2008. Founder: Rubina.
> 13 specialities, 100+ services, every starting price published. Rated 4.6/5 on Google (19 reviews).

## Key facts

- Address: Plot 165/G-1, Saima Terrace, Block 3, PECHS, Karachi 75400, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 322 2782254
- Hours: Monday-Saturday 11:00am-7:00pm, closed Sunday
- Online booking: https://farwasalon.com/book (free cancellation up to 2 hours before)
- Payments: cash, JazzCash, EasyPaisa (no cards)
